title: AO Gear Optimization Engine
description: Full-stack static web app for Arcane Odyssey gear loadout optimization. Vite+React+TypeScript+Tailwind with dark fantasy theme. Exhaustive search with configurable fitness function, constraint system, Web Worker computation. All game data externalized as JSON for future scraper ingestion.

title: Fitness function: configurable scoring with soft constraints
description: Implement the fitness scoring algorithm. SoftConstraint types: minimize, maximize, atLeast, atMost, target, exactly. Each has stat, type, value?, weight (1-100), hardCap?. Scoring: atLeast penalizes (value-actual)*weight*10 below threshold, gives diminishing bonus above. atMost penalizes above threshold. target penalizes deviation. exactly disqualifies on mismatch. hardCap returns -Infinity. Default Mage preset: defense atLeast 700 w100, power atLeast 100 w90, dexterity target 300 hardCap 330 w80, size target 300 hardCap 330 w70, insanity exactly 1 w100, drawback atMost 2 w100. Additional presets: Warrior (power/dex focus), Tank (defense/warding focus). Pure function, full test coverage.

title: UI: Fitness function editor with presets
description: Fitness function editor panel. Add/remove stat constraints from a list. Each constraint: stat dropdown, type selector (minimize/maximize/atLeast/atMost/target/exactly), value input, weight slider (1-100), optional hardCap. Visual weight indicator (bar or gradient). Built-in presets: Mage (defense+power+dex+size balanced), Warrior (power+dex focus), Tank (defense+warding). Preset selector with instant-apply. Custom preset: auto-saves current config to localStorage. Constraint summary: show what the optimizer will prioritize. Validation: warn if no constraints set, warn on conflicting constraints. Use design system slider, select, input patterns.

title: External JSON data layer: equipment, enchantments, modifiers, gems
description: Create externalized JSON data files (not hardcoded in TS) for all game data. Design for future scraper ingestion — data files should be the single source of truth, loaded at runtime. Include draft data from spreadsheet: 10 armor sets (Sunken Iron, Sunken Warrior, Vatrachos, Sopharagos, Ravenna Apostle, Omen, Theugrist, Apex, Kraken Band, Lost Chief), 5 standalone accessories (Dex/AtkSize/Power/Defense Amulets, Glass Arcsphere), 6 gems (Agate, Malachite, Candelaria, Painite, Emerald, Sapphire), enchantments (Explosive, Brisk, Powerful, Armored, Virtuous, Charged, Hasty), modifiers (Gilded, Archaic, Blasted, Crystalline, Drowned, Frozen + Atlantean special). Use updated stat names. Add schema validation with Zod for data files. Include TODO markers for missing items: Sandy/Superheated/Abyssal/Imbued modifiers, Lapis Lazuli/Larimar gems, faction modifiers, additional armor sets. TypeScript loader with runtime validation.

title: Stats computation engine + Atlantean logic
description: Implement stats computation: sum base gear stats + enchantment stats + modifier stats + gem stats across all 5 equipment slots. Handle Atlantean modifier special logic: adds +1 insanity, then picks ONE bonus stat (power:13, defense:116, size:38, dexterity:38, range:38, haste:38) that is NOT already present on the base item OR its socketed gems. Handle Gilded modifier: +1 socket. Return complete Stats object. Pure functions, no side effects. Full test coverage with known stat totals from spreadsheet data.

title: Exhaustive search with pruning + Web Worker
description: Implement ExhaustiveSearch strategy. Pre-filter gear by hard constraints. Generate valid accessory combinations respecting helmet/amulet limits and NO DUPLICATES. For each base loadout (chest x legs x acc1 x acc2 x acc3), enumerate enchantment/modifier/gem assignments. Pruning: early-exit on hard constraint violation, branch-and-bound on partial fitness. Use generator/iterator pattern for memory efficiency. Wrap in Web Worker for non-blocking UI. Worker protocol: postMessage for start/stop/progress. Progress callback: (combinationsChecked, totalEstimate, bestScore) for UI progress bar. Return top N results sorted by score. Timeout support. SearchOptions: maxResults, timeout.

title: Constraint validation: hard constraints + loadout legality
description: Implement hard constraint checking for loadout validity. Rules: (1) Exactly 1 chestplate, 1 leggings, 3 accessories. (2) Max 1 accessory-H (helmet). (3) Max 1 accessory-A (amulet). (4) NO duplicate items of any kind across all 5 slots. (5) Virtuous enchantment cannot be on Atlantean-modified piece. (6) Each piece has at most 1 enchantment and 1 modifier. (7) Gem count per piece <= socketCount (Gilded adds +1). (8) Amulets have 0 base sockets (Gilded gives 1). (9) Net insanity (insanity - warding) <= maxNetInsanity (default 1). (10) Drawback < 3 (i.e. <= 2). Return detailed validation result with per-constraint pass/fail for UI feedback. Pure functions.

title: Zustand state management + localStorage persistence
description: Implement Zustand stores following solid-arch principles. Stores: (1) GearPoolStore: enabled/disabled equipment pieces, active enchantments, modifiers, gems. (2) FitnessStore: soft constraints list, active preset name, custom presets. (3) SearchStore: algorithm, status (idle/running/complete/error), progress, results, error state. (4) UIStore: selected result, expanded cards, active panel. localStorage middleware for GearPool and Fitness stores — auto-persist and restore on load. Clean separation of concerns. Typed selectors. No business logic in stores — stores are data + actions only.

title: UI: Search controls + progress feedback
description: Search controls panel. Start/Stop buttons with clear state transitions (idle -> running -> complete/error). Max results slider (5-50, default 10). Progress bar: show combinations checked / estimated total, elapsed time, current best score. Animated progress with estimated completion. Cancel support via Web Worker termination. Error display: styled error cards with actionable messages (e.g., 'No valid loadouts found — try relaxing constraints'). Pre-search validation: check that gear pool has items, constraints are set, show warnings before starting. Status indicator visible from any panel.

title: Update spec.md with current stat names, corrections, and refinement findings
description: Update docs/spec.md to reflect dialectical refinement findings. Changes: (1) Rename stats: attackSize->size, agility->range, intensity->haste. (2) Add missing stats: pierce, resistance. (3) Add missing modifiers: Sandy, Superheated, Abyssal, Imbued, faction mods. (4) Fix slot name: boots->leggings in slot type union. (5) Add no-duplicate-items constraint. (6) Note rarity rename: Exotic->Mystic. (7) Document Atlantean rule clarification: picks stat not on base item OR gems. (8) Add OUT OF SCOPE section (GA, CSV export, URL sharing, mobile-optimized, light theme). (9) Update implementation phases to match beads structure. (10) Add data externalization requirement.

title: Repo scaffold: Vite+React+TS strict, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Vitest, ESLint
description: Initialize the repository using repo-init and typescript-pro skills. Set up: Vite 6 + React 19 + TypeScript 5.7 strict mode. Tailwind CSS 4 with dark fantasy theme foundation. shadcn/ui component library (Radix primitives). Vitest for testing. ESLint flat config + Prettier. Zustand for state. Web Worker types. Ensure .gitignore includes history/ dir, node_modules, dist, .env, etc. CLAUDE.md with project conventions. Package.json scripts for dev, build, test, lint, typecheck.
close_reason: Repo scaffolded: Vite 7 + React 19 + TS 5.9 strict + Tailwind 4 + shadcn/ui + Vitest + ESLint strict. Dark fantasy theme tokens. All quality gates pass.

title: UI: Gear pool configuration panel
description: Gear pool configuration panel. Display all equipment grouped by set with toggle switches to include/exclude each piece. Filter controls: by slot type, set name, tags. Enchantment/modifier/gem pool toggles: which enchantments, modifiers, and gems are available for the optimizer to use. Equipment cards with tooltip showing full stats. Visual indicators: slot type badges, socket count, set grouping. Search/filter input for large lists. Select all / deselect all per group. Use design system card and toggle patterns. Stat preview on hover.

title: Design system: dark fantasy theme, tokens, component patterns
description: Create the design system using frontend-design skill. Dark fantasy/game-themed aesthetic (think Path of Exile planner). Dark mode only. Define: color palette (deep blues, purples, amber/gold accents, ember highlights), typography (monospace for stats, sans-serif for UI), spacing/radius tokens, card/panel patterns, stat bar components, glow/highlight effects. Use Tailwind CSS theme config for all tokens. shadcn/ui theme customization. No one-off styling — everything through the design system. Reusable component patterns for: stat displays, equipment cards, constraint indicators (green/yellow/red), progress bars, tooltips.

title: UI: Results display with build cards + stat indicators
description: Results display panel. Sortable table of top builds: rank, score, key stats summary. Expandable build cards showing full loadout: each slot with equipment name, enchantment, modifier, gem assignments. Stat satisfaction indicators: green (meets/exceeds constraint), yellow (close to threshold), red (violates constraint). Total stats summary with bar visualization. Copy build to clipboard (formatted text). JSON export of build details. Gear tooltip cards on hover showing individual piece contribution. Comparison mode: highlight stat differences between builds. Empty state: styled message when no results yet.

title: Domain types: Stats, Equipment, Enchantment, Modifier, Gem, Loadout
description: Define all TypeScript interfaces using typescript-pro strict patterns and solid-arch principles. Use current in-game stat names: power, defense, size (was attackSize), dexterity, range (was agility), haste (was intensity), insanity, warding, drawback, regeneration, pierce, resistance. Interfaces: Stats (all 12 stats as numbers), EquipmentPiece (id, name, setName?, slot union type, baseStats, socketCount, maxLevel, tags), Enchantment (id, name, tier, applicableTo, stats, incompatibleWith?), Modifier (id, name, stats, grantsSocket?, atlanteanBehavior?), Gem (id, name, tier, stats), Loadout (5 equipped slots with enchant/modifier/gem assignments), HardConstraints, SoftConstraint, SearchStrategy interface. Slot types: chestplate | leggings | accessory | accessory-H | accessory-A. No duplicate items of any kind in loadouts. Export all from barrel index.

title: Integration tests: known builds, constraint validation, edge cases
description: Integration test suite. Test cases: (1) Stats computation with known spreadsheet values — manually compute total for a specific loadout and verify. (2) Constraint validation: valid loadout passes, duplicate items rejected, helmet/amulet limits enforced, Virtuous+Atlantean rejected. (3) Fitness scoring: verify Mage preset scores correctly for known builds. (4) Search: small gear pool with known optimal result — verify search finds it. (5) Edge cases: empty gear pool, all constraints fail (returns empty), single item per slot. (6) Atlantean modifier stat selection logic. (7) Gilded socket count increase. (8) Data loading: JSON files parse and validate correctly. Use Vitest.

title: UI: App shell, layout, navigation, error boundary
description: Create the app shell using frontend-design skill with dark fantasy theme. Layout: sidebar navigation or tab-based panel switching (Gear Pool | Fitness | Search | Results). Global error boundary with styled fallback. Loading states with skeleton loaders. Toast/notification system for user feedback (search complete, export success, validation errors). Responsive but desktop-first. Use design system tokens exclusively — no one-off styles. shadcn/ui Sheet/Dialog/Tabs components themed to dark fantasy palette.
